8. FAQ - 13 frequently asked questions

## What Claude Cowork Is

Claude Cowork (aka Claude Desktop or Claude macOS) is Anthropic's desktop AI assistant for knowledge workers. Unlike Claude Code (terminal-based developer tool), Cowork is designed for non-technical users who want to automate file operations, create documents, extract data from PDFs/images (OCR), and orchestrate workflows across their local files.

Key differentiators:
- Direct file system access (read, write, move, organize files)
- OCR and document extraction from images and PDFs
- PowerPoint, Word, Excel creation and editing
- Browser automation (screenshots, form filling, web research)
- Local-first, no cloud storage required
- Works with any file type via MCP servers

## Security Model

Claude Cowork has direct access to your filesystem. The guide recommends:
- Dedicated workspace folder (never run from ~ root)
- Regular backups before automation tasks
- Review all changes before confirming
- Understand the 7 golden rules before starting
